module: LuaJIT profiler displayed in an ImGui window "LuaJIT Profiler". The first part of the file is Mike Pall's jit/p module (MIT, 2005-2017) adapted: sampling of LuaJIT's built-in profiler (jit.profile) and formatting of the result into a string instead of stdout. The end of the file is the BeamNG part: every 3 seconds, the profile is finished, its text displayed in the window, then a new profile is started with the mode "vzm0lspi0 500 -500" (VM states, zones, minimum 0%, split, full paths, interval 0 ms...).
usage: extensions.load('ui_improfiler') -- the window appears; the text is refreshed every 3 s
notes: The file does require('libs/LuaJIT/vmdef') while the game's copy is in common/jit/vmdef.lua: different path (no proven bug, just to keep in mind).
Only onUpdate is exposed; the profile starts at the first 3 s cycle (prof_finish does nothing as long as no profile is running).
Time is accumulated with dtReal (real time, unaffected by slow motion).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: draws the "LuaJIT Profiler" window with the latest result; every 3 s of real time, finishes the current profile, updates the displayed text and restarts the profiler.

dtReal.desc: Real delta time (s), accumulated for the 3 s timer.
